registri_numerazione.help: The numbering registers of this issuer: one per document family (delivery notes, orders, jobs, returns) and more than one for invoices. This is where the number FORMAT is governed — prefix, suffix and how many digits — and it is the only place it can be changed.

registri_numerazione.disattiva_confirm: Deactivate register {codice}? The register stays and keeps occupying its slot: it cannot be replaced by a new one on the same combination, only reactivated.
registri_numerazione.anno_nel_numero_hint: Whether the year appears inside the number string. Decided by the document family, not chosen here: without it, a register that resets every year repeats the same string across years.
registri_numerazione.anteprima_hint: What the first number issued by this register will look like.
registri_numerazione.serie_hint: The counter series. Not editable here: changing it on a live register moves the sub-ledger.
registri_numerazione.reset_hint: How the counter behaves at year change. Chosen at creation and not editable: on a register that has already numbered it would restart the number from 1.

famiglie_documento.sezione_forma: Shape new registers are born with
famiglie_documento.sorgente_hint: A family belongs to a source: its code becomes the family's internal code, and the documents' table is the source's table. On creation the code shown in the list equals the internal code; it can be changed afterwards, when editing.
famiglie_documento.sorgente_ha_famiglia: It already has a family: if that one is off, switch it back on.
famiglie_documento.sorgente_tabella_numerata: Its table is already numbered by the active family “{famiglia}”.
famiglie_documento.tabella_dalla_sorgente: It is the source's table: it is not typed in, the source catalogue states it.
famiglie_documento.codice_immutabile: The code cannot be changed: it is the target of the registers' reference, and changing it would detach them all.
famiglie_documento.serie_hint: Empty = this family does not handle series. If you fill it in, that column must also tell numbers apart on the document itself.
famiglie_documento.billing_account_hint: Empty = this family has no billing account (for instance a purchase order, whose counterparty is a supplier).
famiglie_documento.registri_hint: The count is across every issuer in the system, not just one: a family is global, and its registers are born on each of them. It is also why the columns above can no longer be changed.
famiglie_documento.forma_hint: These are the values a new register of this family is born with: the one you create by hand and the one the system creates on its own must have the same number shape.
famiglie_documento.fiscali_hint: Only the invoice allows issue limits and a non-neutral date policy: a family created here is born without them, and that is a limit of the model, not of this form.
famiglie_documento.presidia_hint: If true, a document gets no number when its date is earlier than the last one already numbered on the same register. ⚠️ It is a different question from the one below, even when the answer is the same.
famiglie_documento.conferma_disattiva: Deactivate family {codice}? It drops out of the guards that iterate it, and its documents stop holding the customer they were numbered under.
famiglie_documento.salvata_con_registri: Family created, and with it {registri} numbering registers on the issuers that had none.

disattiva_blocco.ha_registri_attivi: Family {codice_interno} still has {registri} active numbering registers: switch those off first. A switched-off family drops out of the guards that iterate it, and its registers would keep numbering with nobody watching them.
disattiva_blocco.ha_documenti_numerati: Family {codice_interno} already has {documenti} numbered documents in {tabella}: switching it off would drop them from the guard on the customer's issuer change, and those documents would stop holding the customer they were numbered under. Numbers already issued cannot be undone.

struttura_blocco.ha_registri: The columns that say where the document lives cannot be changed: {registri} numbering registers already carry the defaults of family {codice_interno}. Change what depends on them first, or create a new family.

disattiva_blocco.ha_commesse: Register {codice} has already numbered {quante} jobs: deactivating it would leave those documents without the register that numbered them. And a job is never deleted, so from here on this register can no longer be switched off.
disattiva_blocco.ha_fatture: Register {codice} has already issued {quante} invoices: deactivating it would leave those documents without the register that numbered them.
disattiva_blocco.ha_progressivi: Register {codice} has {quante} counters still active: while a counter is alive the register can still number, and switching it off would break the sequence. Switch off the counters first.
disattiva_blocco.ha_mapping_tipo_doc: Register {codice} is assigned to {quante} document types: remove the assignment first, otherwise those documents would no longer find a register to be created in.
disattiva_blocco.ha_ordini: Register {codice} has already numbered {quante} orders: deactivating it would leave those documents without the register that numbered them.
disattiva_blocco.ha_ddt: Register {codice} has already numbered {quante} delivery notes: deactivating it would leave those documents without the register that numbered them.
disattiva_blocco.ha_resi: Register {codice} has already numbered {quante} returns: deactivating it would leave those documents without the register that numbered them.
disattiva_blocco.ha_distinte: Register {codice} has already numbered {quante} collection sheets: deactivating it would leave those documents without the register that numbered them. And a collection sheet is never deleted, so from here on this register can no longer be switched off.

forma_blocco.ha_numerato: Register {codice} has already issued numbers (last: {ultimo_numero}): the number format can no longer be changed. The counter does not restart when the format changes, it carries on — so the same register would hold two formats with consecutive numbers.

serie_blocco.non_gestita: Documents in the {famiglia_documento} family do not record the series anywhere: giving this register series {serie} would open a new counter, restarting from 1 over numbers already issued — and the document would no longer get a number. A series can only be used where the document carries it in a column.

processi.accendi_spiegazione: The process will start again at its next schedule, on this installation.
processi.spegni_spiegazione: The process will no longer start, neither from its schedule nor with «Run now», until you switch it back on.
processi.torna_al_default_spiegazione: The manual choice is removed: the process goes back on or off as its default for the environment says.
processi.sveglie_nessuna: No deployment schedule declared for this process: if it runs, something else wakes it (pgAgent, for instance).
processi.sveglia_dovuto_mese: on day {giorno} of every month from {dalle} (company time)
processi.esegui_ora_tooltip: Queues one run of this schedule under your identity: it starts at the drainer's next pass.

esegui_ora_blocco.non_avviabile_a_mano: This schedule is declared not startable by hand in the deployment: its command is not suited to «Run now» (it is long by nature, or it is the drainer itself).

esegui_ora_blocco.non_decidibile: It is not known whether the process is on: the environment of this installation has not been declared.
esegui_ora_blocco.gia_in_coda: Already queued (job #{job_id}): it can be pressed again once that job has finished.

amministrazione.riuso_credenziale_sparita: This email no longer has a credential: save again.

secondo_fattore.obbligo_dal_profilo: It is required anyway by an assigned profile (super administrator or department): remove it from the profile, not here.
secondo_fattore.disattiva_spiegazione: The user's device is deleted (for example, lost phone). Open sessions remain. If two-factor authentication is required, they will have to set it up again at next sign-in.
secondo_fattore.richiesto_dal_profilo_aiuto: Members of this department must use two-factor authentication.

accessi.sblocca_conferma: The person will be able to sign in again with their password, through every entry point.
accessi.blocca_spiegazione: The person will no longer be able to sign in through any entry point (back office, portal, shop) and their open sessions are closed. The block does not expire and a password change does not remove it: only «Unblock access» does.

blocca_reason.credenziale_di_sistema: This is the access of an automated process or an external system: blocking it would stop its work.
blocca_reason.ultimo_super_admin: This is the only administrator without an end date: blocking it would leave the system without administrators.

accessi.elimina_conferma: The access «{username}» never had a role and will be deleted. A record of who deleted it and when is kept. This cannot be undone.

elimina_reason.con_vesti: It has roles, even switched off: it belongs to a person or to an automated process, and it cannot be deleted. To stop a person from signing in, switch off their roles from their record.
elimina_reason.con_storia: It already appears in the recorded data ({dove}): it cannot be deleted. Tell the developers, quoting this message.
elimina_reason.storia_non_verificabile: This installation lacks the database links to the credentials: it cannot be checked whether it has a history, so it cannot be deleted. Tell whoever administers the database.

accessi.nessun_accesso_spiegazione: This access has no role: it cannot sign in anywhere. It needs fixing, and the check of credentials to fix reports it too: if the person must sign in, invite them from their record with the same email (the invitation reuses this access); otherwise delete it.

azione_reason.causale_mancante: Transport reason is missing: required to issue the DDT.
azione_reason.cliente_mancante: The transport reason sends the goods to a customer and the delivery note has no customer (billing account): choose it before issuing, or choose the right reason (transfer, subcontracting, repair).
azione_reason.prezzo_non_risolvibile: One or more rows have no resolvable price (own or inherited from the order) with an invoiceable reason.
azione_reason.iva_mancante: One or more rows have a price but no VAT rate. The rate is not chosen on the document: set it on the item, and the row picks it up. Otherwise remove the price, if the goods are not valued.
azione_reason.magazzino_mancante: The delivery note has no departure warehouse: without it the goods cannot be unloaded.
azione_reason.magazzino_arrivo_mancante: The transfer delivery note has no arrival warehouse.
azione_reason.prelievi_incompleti: One or more lines have picks that do not cover their quantity: complete the picks before issuing.
azione_reason.merce_non_prelevabile: A pick is not accepted by the warehouse (lot, serial or location not valid for the item): open it from the line picks.
azione_reason.merce_non_disponibile: The goods to ship are not available in stock in sufficient quantity.
azione_reason.solo_oneri: The delivery note has only charges and no goods: it cannot be issued. Add the goods, or remove the charges and bill them on the job order.
azione_reason.onere_non_fatturabile: A line is a charge that would never be invoiced: the delivery note's reason is not invoiceable, or the order is invoiced on confirmation and then the charge belongs on the order.
azione_reason.trasporto_non_dovuto: The delivery note bills the transport to the customer, but carriage is forward or charged to a third party: the customer does not owe it to us. Remove the transport line, or change the transport charge.

correggi_qta_evasa_reason.ddt_non_in_bozza: The shipped quantity can only be corrected while the delivery note is a draft.
correggi_qta_evasa_reason.riga_non_evasa: The line does not come from an order or a return: change the quantity from the line.
correggi_qta_evasa_reason.ddt_senza_origine: The delivery note does not come from an order or a return: change the quantity from the line.
correggi_qta_evasa_reason.legami_multipli: The line is linked to several source lines: the shipped quantity cannot be corrected on its own.
correggi_qta_evasa_reason.riga_onere: The line is a charge: the shipped quantity correction applies to goods only.

ddt.correggi_qta_evasa_spiegazione: Line {riga} comes from an order or a return: the new quantity also changes what is shipped for the source, and the order status.
ddt.riga_evasa_hint: Line shipped from an order or a return: item, unit of measure and quantity cannot be changed here. Correct the quantity with «Correct shipped quantity».

azione_reason.fatture_non_pre_fiscali: The batch contains invoices beyond the pre-fiscal stage: they cannot be deleted.
azione_reason.fatture_numerate: The batch contains already numbered invoices: deleting them would leave a gap in the fiscal numbering.
azione_reason.plafond_consumato: The batch contains invoices that have already used the allowance of a declaration of intent: they cannot be undone. Move the batch forward: finalising it does not use the allowance twice.
azione_reason.lotto_non_pre_fiscale: The batch is beyond the pre-fiscal stage: nothing can be removed from it any more, neither invoices nor documents.
azione_reason.documento_senza_esito: This document is not part of this run: reload the batch.
azione_reason.documento_gia_uscito: This document has already been removed from this run.
azione_reason.documento_non_in_errore: Only failed documents can be removed from the run.
azione_reason.fattura_non_collegata: The invoice does not belong to this batch.
azione_reason.fattura_non_pre_fiscale: The invoice is beyond the pre-fiscal stage: it cannot be deleted.
azione_reason.fattura_numerata: The invoice is already numbered: deleting it would leave a gap in the fiscal numbering.
azione_reason.fattura_plafond_consumato: The invoice has already used the allowance of a declaration of intent: it cannot be deleted. Move the batch forward: finalising it does not use the allowance twice.
azione_reason.righe_rettificate: This batch contains rows that rectify another invoice: the credit is already recorded and cannot be undone from here.

lotti.azione_non_piu_disponibile: This action is no longer available on this batch: the list has been refreshed.

offerte.esito_rifiutata_messaggio: Confirm the customer rejected the offer? The state is terminal: to re-propose, create a new offer.
offerte.esito_annullata_messaggio: Confirm offer cancellation? A cancelled offer can no longer be issued or converted.
offerte.esito_warn_motivazione: Reason is required and is stored in the offer history.

offerte.successione_messaggio: An active contract already exists for this customer/utility in the given period. To generate the new contract you must close the existing one (succession).
offerte.successione_effetto: On confirmation, the existing contract will be closed on {data} and the new draft contract will be generated.

azione_reason.listino_senza_versione_in_vigore: The price list has no version in force today: publish one or choose another price list.
azione_reason.listino_versione_non_attiva: The linked price list version is not ACTIVE.
azione_reason.documenti_vivi: The offer generated a contract or an order that is not cancelled: to cancel the offer, cancel that document first.

offerte.aggiungi_articolo_tooltip: Add to the offer an article not present in the reference price list (AGGIUNTA).

ordini.search_placeholder: Search by number, customer, account code, tax id...
ordini.field_billing_account_placeholder: Search customer by name, code, VAT...
ordini.fatturazione_trigger_hint: Event that triggers billing: on confirmation, on shipment or on delivery.
ordini.fatturazione_immediata_hint: Routes the document to the fast lane: it will be invoiced by the automatic run without waiting for the monthly cycle. It is decided before the job order push; afterwards it can no longer be changed. To invoice work already in a job order right now, use targeted issuing from the Competence cockpit.
ordini.riga_prezzo_auto_hint: Leave empty to resolve the price from the price list.
ordini.componenti_section_hint: The parent price is the sum of the components.
ordini.conferma_abbandono_bozza: The draft has no lines and will be deleted. Continue?

azione_reason.ddt_collegati: The order already has linked DDTs: the goods are out, and to bring them back you register a return.
azione_reason.gia_in_commessa: The order has already been sent to invoicing: cancel the job order activities first.
azione_reason.iva_mancante: One or more rows have a price but no VAT rate. The rate is not chosen on the document: set it on the item, and the row picks it up. Otherwise remove the price, if the goods are not valued.
azione_reason.solo_oneri: The order has only charges and no goods: it cannot be confirmed. Add the goods the charge refers to, or bill it on the job order.

stato_info.evaso: The order is fulfilled: its status is recalculated from the DDTs, it is not set by hand.
stato_info.parzialmente_evaso: Fulfilment in progress: the status is recalculated at every DDT.
stato_info.annullato: The order is cancelled: this state is final.
stato_info.fatturato: The order is invoiced: follow-up happens on the invoice.

ordini.conferma_ordine_messaggio: Confirm the order? After confirmation the lines can no longer be edited.
ordini.push_commessa_messaggio: Send the order to job for billing?
ordini.push_commessa_skipped: Push already in progress for this order.

push_commessa_reason.non_confermato: Sending to a job will be available once the order is confirmed.
push_commessa_reason.fattura_da_ddt: This order is invoiced from the DDT: it is sent to a job on shipping or delivery.
push_commessa_reason.gia_inviato: Order already sent to a job: its lines are awaiting invoicing.
push_commessa_reason.gia_fatturato: Order already sent to a job and invoiced.
push_commessa_reason.nessuna_riga_pushabile: No line can be sent to a job: check line quantities and prices.
push_commessa_reason.annullato: The order is cancelled: it does not go to invoicing.

data_consegna_confermata_reason.in_bozza: In draft the date is changed by editing the line.
data_consegna_confermata_reason.stato_non_ammette: In this status the delivery date can no longer be changed.
data_consegna_confermata_reason.riga_spedita: The goods on this line have already left with a delivery note: the confirmed delivery date stays the one they left with.
data_consegna_confermata_reason.riga_onere: The line is a charge: a charge is not shipped and has no delivery dates.

ordini.data_consegna_confermata_hint: Leave the field empty to remove the delivery commitment.
ordini.evasione_intro: Select the lines to fulfil and generate the delivery note. The DDT is created as a draft.
ordini.evasione_oneri_nota: One charge of the order is still to be passed on: it is not shipped, it goes whole into the next delivery note on its own. | {n} charges of the order are still to be passed on: they are not shipped, they go whole into the next delivery note on their own.
ordini.evasione_oneri_in_bolla_nota: One charge of the order has already left with a delivery note. | {n} charges of the order have already left with a delivery note.
ordini.evasione_qta_nulla: Set a quantity to fulfil greater than zero.
ordini.evasione_conferma: Generate a DDT for {righe} order lines?
ordini.ddt_generato: Draft DDT generated (number assigned on issue).

pdf.tooltip_lista_disabilitato: Available after the quote is issued

preventivi.bozza_creata: Draft created. Now add quote lines.
preventivi.conferma_abbandono_bozza: You are leaving a quote without lines. The draft will be deleted. Continue?
preventivi.accetta_descrizione: Specify the billing mode for the accepted quote.
preventivi.accetta_competenza_hint_immediata: Period is automatically set to the current month.
preventivi.accetta_competenza_required: Period is required when billing is not immediate.
preventivi.banner_revisione_superseded: Superseded revision: a newer revision exists. This version is read-only for historical integrity.
preventivi.revisioni_intro: Chain of revisions sharing the same quote number.
preventivi.field_billing_account_placeholder: Search by company name, BA code, fiscal code or PDP
preventivi.field_istanza_utility_placeholder: Search instance by code, company name or address
preventivi.istanza_da_billing_account: Instance automatically derived from the billing account.
preventivi.emissione_messaggio: Confirm issuance of this quote to the customer? Once issued, it can be accepted, rejected, or superseded by a revision.
preventivi.limiti_prezzo_hint: Allowed price variation for your role: discount up to {sconto}%, markup up to {maggiorazione}%.
preventivi.limiti_prezzo_hint_con_cliente: Allowed price variation for your role on this customer: discount up to {sconto}%, markup up to {maggiorazione}%.
preventivi.limiti_prezzo_non_autorizzato: You are not allowed to modify the price suggested by the price list. Ask your manager to grant the 'prezzo_override_manuale' permission.
preventivi.limiti_prezzo_zero_autorizzato: Price override authorized but no percentage variation allowed (max discount 0%, max markup 0%). Ask your manager to set VENDITE_MAX_SCONTO_PCT and VENDITE_MAX_MAGGIORAZIONE_PCT.
preventivi.limiti_prezzo_zero: You are not allowed to modify the price suggested by the price list. Ask your manager for a variation limit.
preventivi.contesto_pricing_contratto_tooltip: Prices are resolved from the customer's active contract price list.
preventivi.contesto_pricing_categoria_tooltip: No active contract: prices are resolved from the price list mapped to the customer's category.
preventivi.contesto_pricing_none_tooltip: No active contract and no category price list mapped for this utility. Enter prices manually or configure contract/category.
preventivi.richiedi_approvazione_tooltip: Create an approval request for the manager.
preventivi.richiesta_approvazione_inviata: Approval request sent. Line waiting for outcome.
preventivi.prezzo_non_risolto: Price not resolved from price list: enter manually.
preventivi.limiti_non_caricati: Discount and markup limits not loaded for this customer: the price will still be checked on save.
preventivi.banner_no_contratto_attivo: The customer has no active contract for this utility at the quote date. Line prices will be proposed from the category price list (category → price list matrix), if configured.
preventivi.badge_approvazione_rejected_tooltip: Price rejected by the manager. Reason: {motivazione}
preventivi.badge_approvazione_rejected_no_motivo: Price rejected by the manager (no reason provided).
preventivi.conferma_elimina_riga: Delete this line from the quote?

push_commessa_reason.non_accettato: Project integration will be available once the quote is accepted.
push_commessa_reason.nessuna_riga: No line to push to a job.
push_commessa_reason.stato_chiuso: The quote is closed: it no longer feeds the job order.

genera_ordine_reason.non_accettato: Order generation will be available once the quote is accepted.
genera_ordine_reason.nessuna_riga: No line: add at least one line to generate the order.
genera_ordine_reason.stato_chiuso: The quote is closed: it no longer generates orders.

azione_reason.ordine_gia_generato: The quote has already generated an order: cancel the linked order first.
azione_reason.gia_in_commessa: The quote has already been sent to invoicing: cancel the job order activities first.
azione_reason.commessa_gia_emessa: Some lines have already been invoiced through the job order: reverse them on the invoicing side, or create a new revision of the quote.
azione_reason.iva_mancante: One or more rows with a quantity have a price but no VAT rate. The rate is not chosen on the document: set it on the item, and the row picks it up. Otherwise remove the price, if the goods are not valued.

preventivi.conferma_revisione: Create a new revision? The current revision will be deactivated.
preventivi.push_commessa_ok_dettaglio: Push completed: {righe} rows sent to invoicing.
preventivi.push_commessa_parziale: Partial push: {righe} rows sent, some failed (audit log id: {push_log_id}).
preventivi.push_commessa_skipped: Push already running: retry in a few seconds.
preventivi.push_commessa_immediata_hint: Quote with immediate invoicing flag: emission to invoiceable activities will happen at the next pipeline run.
preventivi.componenti_section_hint: The parent row price is the sum of each component × quantity coefficient. Edit the component prices to influence the total.
preventivi.componenti_non_caso_a: Article is not composite or has no components exposed in the invoice.
preventivi.componenti_l1_richiede_autorizzazione: Requires the `prezzo_override_manuale` action to modify the component price.
preventivi.componenti_errore_listino_mancante: Price list not configured for component {codice}: configure it in catalog before creating the row.
preventivi.componenti_conferma_elimina: Delete this component from the row? The parent row price will be recalculated.
preventivi.componenti_obbligatorio_zero: Invalid price for mandatory component {codice}: must be non-zero.
preventivi.conferma_smistamento: Dispatch the selected lines? {merce} goods line(s) to a new order, {servizi} service line(s) to invoicing (job).

stato_info.evaso: The quote is fully dispatched: follow-up happens on the generated documents.
stato_info.rifiutato: The quote was rejected: to propose it again, create a new quote.
stato_info.scaduto: The quote validity has passed and cannot be reopened: to propose it again, create a new quote.
stato_info.annullato: The quote is cancelled: this state is final.

promo_articoli.field_articolo_placeholder: Search article by code or description (min 3 characters)...
promo_articoli.field_valore_variazione_hint: Negative for discount, positive for markup. E.g. -10 = 10% discount (PERCENTAGE) or -5 = 5€ discount (FIXED_VALUE).
promo_articoli.identita_immutable_hint: Code, article and UoM are immutable. To change them, disable this promo and create a new one.
promo_articoli.scaduta_readonly_hint: Promo expired — read-only. To change price or period, create a new promo.
promo_articoli.iniziata_warn_hint: Promo already started: only description and end date are editable. To change price or period, close this promo (end date = today) and create a new one.

update_reason.promo_scaduta_immutabile: Promo expired — read-only. To change price or period, create a new promo.

articolo_reason.solo_componente: Item usable only inside a kit: a promotion on it would never apply. Put the promotion on the kit.

resi.field_magazzino_richiesto_conferma: Required to confirm a return that brings goods back: the warehouse the goods return to

rientri.intro: Where the returned goods go back: for each line, from which picking of the delivery note (lot, serial number) and onto which shelf. Lines with nothing to choose are restocked automatically on confirmation.
rientri.senza_magazzino: Choose the return warehouse first: the shelves depend on it.

resi.azione_non_gestita: Action "{azione}" not handled by the client: update the app.
resi.riga_ddt_riga_placeholder: Select the delivery note line to return
resi.riconsegna_intro: Select the lines to reship: a new draft delivery note linked to the return is generated. Quantities in BASE units.
resi.riconsegna_nota_parziale: A quantity lower than the outstanding one generates a partial delivery note: the rest is NOT lost — the line stays in this list with the updated outstanding quantity. You can reship it later or declare it final.
resi.rinuncia_conferma: Mark the returned goods on {righe} lines as final? The goods will NOT go back to the customer: the order closes and the credit becomes due (the amount does not change).
resi.rinuncia_chiusa: Return marked as final: order closed, credit due
resi.rinuncia_riapri_conferma: Undo the final declaration for {qta}? The quantity becomes reshippable again and the order goes back to partially fulfilled.
resi.rinuncia_riaperta: Declaration undone: the quantity is reshippable again

rinuncia_reason.riga_inesistente: The specified return line does not exist
rinuncia_reason.accredito_eseguito: The quantity has already been credited: to reopen the waiver you must first cancel the credit

resi.riconsegna_conferma: Generate the redelivery note for {righe} lines?
resi.riconsegna_qta_nulla: No quantity to reship in the selected lines
resi.crea_intro: Select the delivered lines to return: a draft return linked to this delivery note is created.
resi.crea_conferma: Create a draft return with {righe} lines?
resi.reso_creato: Draft return created: refine and confirm it from the Returns tab
resi.crea_qta_nulla: No quantity to return in the selected lines
resi.coda_search_accreditare: Search (return no., recipient, item, DDT, account)

coda_etichetta.FACOLTATIVA: Credit optional — goods to be redelivered

resi.accredito_conferma_messaggio: Registers the credit for {n} return lines. ⚠️ The credit note is NOT issued now: the document is created on the next invoicing run.
resi.accredito_esito_completato: Credit registered on {n} lines. The credit note will be created on the next invoicing run.
resi.accredito_esito_parziale: {ok} of {totale} lines credited: the others are listed below.
resi.accredito_esito_errore: None of the {n} lines was credited.
resi.annullo_conferma: Removes the registered adjustments: the credit becomes due again in the queue and the returned goods can be credited again.
resi.annullo_avviso_reset: This cancels the CREDIT, not the document. If the credit note has been issued but not numbered yet, the way is to reset the batch — which however REGENERATES it on the next run.
resi.annullo_esito: Credit cancelled: the line is back in the queue.

annullo_blocco.nessun_accredito: There is no credit to undo on this line.
annullo_blocco.fuori_perimetro: This credit cannot be undone here: it could not be reconstructed in full. Please report the return.
annullo_blocco.rettifica_emessa: The credit has already been issued on an invoice and can no longer be undone.

coda_blocco.GIA_ACCREDITATO: This line has already been credited: the remaining amount is no longer due.

annulla_reason.con_accrediti: The return has a registered credit: undo the credit on the line first, then the return.

azione_reason.magazzino_mancante: The return does not say which warehouse the goods come back to: choose it on the header, then confirm.
azione_reason.rientri_incompleti: Return line {0}: {1} pieces given out of {2}. Specify which lots or serials come back, and where.
azione_reason.merce_non_ricollocabile: A return line cannot come back into the chosen warehouse: open the line's inbound entries to see what is missing.
azione_reason.rientro_oltre_uscito: Return line {0}: {1} pieces would come back from a lot or serial that shipped only {2}. Check the other returns on the same delivery note too.

stato_info.confermato: The return is confirmed: the goods are back and the stock movements are recorded.
stato_info.annullato: The return is cancelled: the inbound movement was reversed and this state is final.

situazione_aperta.page_description: Pre-order backlog: open documents by phase, regardless of period.
situazione_aperta.card_ordini_hint: Orders invoiced on ship/delivery count only the not-yet-shipped value (the rest is carried by the delivery note). Orders invoiced on confirmation keep their full value.
situazione_aperta.nessun_documento: No open documents with the current filters.

situazione_merce.anticipato: including {n} already invoiced and not yet shipped
situazione_merce.in_riconsegna: {n} returned, already on an unissued document
situazione_merce.nessuna_merce: No goods to count on this document.
situazione_merce.sospetta_hint: Line added manually on an order-backed shipment, with an item already present in the order: it may be intended extra goods or a duplicate.
situazione_merce.sez_righe_ordine_hint_ddt: How these order lines stand overall, other shipments included.
situazione_merce.riepilogo_base_ordine: The count below is the one of the order lines. Shipments are the same quantities seen per single delivery note: it is not extra goods.
situazione_merce.riepilogo_base_ddt: The count below is the one of this shipment. Order lines cover the whole order: it is not extra goods.
situazione_merce.nc_spiegazione: The credit is registered from the credits queue: the credit note is created at the next invoicing run.

fondi_fattura_da_decidere.nessuna_riga: No fund is waiting for a decision.
fondi_fattura_da_decidere.cancella_messaggio: The {importo} entry on invoice {numero} will be deleted. This cannot be undone: the entry leaves no audit trail, because it never moved any money. The automatic run may propose a new one from the balance at that time.

tool_fatturazione.page_description: The lists the automatic run produces but cannot close by itself: a person decides them here.

azione_reason.non_trovata: Activities no longer available: the list you are looking at has changed. Refresh it and try again.
azione_reason.ancora_in_fattura: The work is already inside an invoice: it cannot be sent back to be issued. If the invoice must be redone, act on the invoice — «Remove from batch» for that document, or «Back to processing» for the whole batch.
azione_reason.gia_da_emettere: The work is already ready to be issued: there is nothing to send back, the next invoicing run will pick it up on its own.
azione_reason.in_lavorazione: The work is inside an invoicing run still in progress: it is not a leftover. Wait for the batch to finish.

azione_reason.righe_commessa_emesse: The document has job lines already issued: it cannot be closed while they are there. Recover them first from the accrual dashboard, «Issued not invoiced» card, with the «Send back to be issued» action.

iva_origine.TITOLO: Customer VAT title (e.g. letter of intent)
iva_origine.ASSENTE: No rate resolved: it must be chosen

blocco_reason.trattenuto_da_lotto: A live batch is already holding this document: to invoice it separately, remove it from that run first.

giornale.filtro_solo_errori_hint: On: ERROR rows only (and rows without severity). Off: warnings too.
giornale.storia_non_caricata: History is not available right now.
giornale.storia_solo_info: No issues: all {n} recorded events are routine.
giornale.storia_solo_ritirate: No active events: all {n} recorded signals belong to retried attempts.

canoni.hint_mese_partenza_canone: The month periods are counted from: quarterly from February means Feb-Apr, May-Jul, Aug-Oct, Nov-Jan.

distinte.solo_consultazione: This screen is read-only: opening a sheet, entering lines, matching them to instalments and posting are coming in the next round.
distinte.nessuna_riga: This sheet has no lines yet
distinte.righe_non_lette: The sheet lines could not be read: reload before working on them.
distinte.apri_tooltip: Open the sheet for a day's collected money
distinte.emittente_aiuto: The statement is numbered on the issuer's register: without a channel it is the one you are working with.
distinte.emittente_dal_canale: The issuer is the one of the selected channel.
distinte.dichiarato_aiuto: The total written on top of the incoming sheet: used for reconciliation.
distinte.nessun_canale: No collection channel configured: the sheet can be opened by picking the collection centre directly.
distinte.gia_popolata: This sheet already existed and holds {righe} lines: check before adding more.
distinte.foglio_annullato: This batch is cancelled: its lines are read-only.
distinte.foglio_chiuso: This batch is in state «{stato}»: it accepts no new lines. Suspended and discarded lines can still be worked.
distinte.contenuto_fermo: Batch validated: its content is frozen. A line can still be matched or suspended; to add, correct or delete, reopen the batch to draft.
distinte.mostra_scartate_hint: Discarded lines (“not ours”) stay in the batch and in the reconciliation, but leave the work queue: hidden by default.

stato_info.bozza: Draft: being entered. Lines can be added, corrected and deleted.
stato_info.validata: Validated: ready to be posted. The money is not posted yet — balances show it as “in progress”.
stato_info.chiusa: Posted: the movements exist and balances have changed. There is no way back; correct it with a batch of opposite sign.
stato_info.importata: Imported: loaded from a file, not yet reviewed.

validazione_reason.righe_non_lavorate: The batch has {quante} lines nobody has worked yet: it is validated only once every line has been reviewed — matched, suspended with a reason or discarded.
validazione_reason.totale_non_quadra: Declared {importo_dichiarato}, but the lines add up to {somma_righe}: either a line is missing, an amount was mistyped, or the declared total was wrong. If not needed, the declared total can be left empty.

righe.destinazione_assente: Unidentified line: it has neither a document nor an instalment. The destination is set with "{azione}".
righe.gia_registrata: The line is already posted: it cannot be changed.

elimina_reason.distinta_annullata: The batch is cancelled: its lines are read-only.
elimina_reason.distinta_finale: The batch is closed: its lines can no longer be deleted.
elimina_reason.distinta_non_manuale: The batch was not entered by hand: its lines cannot be deleted from here. For one produced by the system act on what generated it (invoice fund or adjustment); for one loaded from a file cancel it and import it again.
elimina_reason.distinta_validata: The batch is validated: reopen it to draft with «Reopen», delete the line, then validate it again.

righe.conferma_elimina: Delete the line of {importo} ({riferimento})? It disappears from the list and from the balancing: it is not money received, it is a mistyped line.
righe.non_identificata_aiuto: The line is created without a document and shows up in “To match”: it is the exception, not the rule.

rate_fuori_capienza.motivo_nota_credito_movimento_contrario: Came in instead of going out

abbina.campo_fattura_placeholder: Search by number, customer or VAT number (min. 3 characters)
abbina.motivo_aiuto: Whoever settles the excess will read it, even weeks later.
abbina.forzatura_resta_scritta: The forcing stays recorded on the line
abbina.gia_cosi: The line is already matched like this: change the document or the instalment to re-match it.
abbina.registra_irreversibile: The batch is already posted: this line is matched and posted now, with a movement of its own. There is no way back.
abbina.registrata: Line posted late: movement of {importo} written, the batch stays closed.
abbina.non_da_questo_stato: The line cannot be matched from this status: take it back first (“Resume”).

rata.facoltativa: Optional: the payment can be matched to the document without an instalment.
rata.nessuna: This invoice has no instalments: it is matched to the document.
rata.non_lette: Could not read this invoice's instalments: retry before matching without one.

rate.criterio_obbligatorio: Enter the customer or the invoice number: instalments are listed from there.
rate.esaurita: Instalment settled: nothing left to collect
rate.non_lette: Could not read the instalments: retry.
rate.titolo_righe_da_rate: Lines from instalments: pick the instalments, each one becomes a line
rate.seleziona_pagina: Select the instalments on this page
rate.area_titolo: Chosen instalments | One chosen instalment | {n} chosen instalments
rate.nessuna_scelta: Tick the instalments to collect: each chosen instalment becomes a line of the remittance, with the amount proposed from its remaining space.
rate.crea_righe: Create the lines | Create one line | Create {n} lines
rate.create: No line created | One line created | {n} lines created
rate.parziale: {riuscite} of {richieste} lines created: the others stay here, each with its reason.
rate.abbandona_msg: {n} chosen instalments are not saved yet: close and lose them?

registra.irreversibile: Posting creates the movements and cannot be undone.
registra.niente_da_registrare: No line is ready: they must be matched to an invoice first.
registra.scarto_aperto: Reconciliation does not add up: {importo} off. You can still post, but it is worth a look.
registra.anteprima_non_letta: The preview could not be read: you cannot post from here, because posting without seeing what you post is the leap in the dark this window exists to prevent.
registra.nulla_da_postare: Nothing was posted: this sheet had no ready lines.

blocco.stato: Only a validated batch can be posted: move it to Validated first (“I have finished entering”).

valida.spiegazione: Validating means “I have finished entering”: every line has been reviewed — matched, suspended with a reason or discarded — and the batch is ready to be posted. The money is not posted yet.

canali.nessun_canale: No collection channel configured: until there is one, money arriving before the invoice has no perimeter.
canali.perche_il_conto: The account tells whose the money is when it arrives before the invoice: with more than one VAT number active, a wrong account moves money into another issuer's perimeter without raising an error.
canali.emittente_dal_permesso: It is your perimeter: it selects the right accounts and is not saved on the channel.
canali.emittente_dal_conto: Derived from the channel bank account.
canali.emittente_dalla_sessione: Session working issuer (change it from the top bar).
canali.campo_conto_placeholder: Choose the account the money lands on
canali.conti_non_letti: The accounts could not be read: retry before concluding there are none.
canali.nessun_conto_di_incasso: This issuer has no account with use «collection» registered at role level: until there is one, the channel cannot be configured.
canali.filiale_obbligatoria: Required on Bank channels, and forbidden on the others.
canali.psp_obbligatorio: Required on PSP channels. It is not the issuer: it is the payment service provider.
canali.formato_flusso_aiuto: The format of the file this channel delivers, when it delivers one.
canali.conto_fuori_elenco: The account configured on this channel is no longer among the attachable ones (expired, blocked, or moved to another use): it stays saved until you pick another one.
canali.emittenti_non_letti: The issuers could not be read: without them, the attachable accounts cannot be requested.

sistemazioni.nessun_atto: Nobody has decided anything on this document yet.
sistemazioni.atti_non_letti: The existing decisions could not be read: retry before taking a new one.
sistemazioni.importo_aiuto: Part of it can be settled: a document can carry more than one act.
sistemazioni.destinatario_aiuto: Same customer only: a credit is not carried onto someone else's document.
sistemazioni.motivo_aiuto: Whoever meets this decision weeks from now will read it.
sistemazioni.registrata: Decision registered: the money moves on confirmation.
sistemazioni.conferma_irreversibile: On confirmation the money moves and there is no way back: a correction is a new settlement.
sistemazioni.campo_canale_placeholder: Which account the transfer leaves from
sistemazioni.canale_aiuto: It is asked now because it is a decision of the moment you pay.
sistemazioni.canali_non_letti: The channels could not be read: retry before concluding there are none.
sistemazioni.nessun_canale: No collection channel configured: without one, the refund has no account to leave from.
sistemazioni.annullo_aiuto: Required if the decision had none: a decision discarded without a reason cannot be reconstructed.
sistemazioni.gia_terminale: The decision is already {stato}: it cannot be confirmed twice.
sistemazioni.annullo_gia_annullata: The decision has already been discarded.
sistemazioni.annullo_solo_riporto: A confirmed refund or offset cannot be cancelled: correct it with the guided correction on its accounting batch.

correggi.che_cosa_fa: A new sheet is created, as a draft, with the lines of {codice} reversed in sign — invoice and instalment included. No money moves until you post it.
correggi.data_aiuto: It is the date of the new sheet, not of the one you are correcting.
correggi.motivo_aiuto: It stays written on the new sheet: whoever finds two twin documents of opposite sign will read it.
correggi.solo_le_registrate: Only posted lines are reversed: the others produced no movements, so there is nothing to correct.
correggi.creata: Correction created, with {righe} lines to match.
correggi.creata_con_saltate: Correction created with {righe} lines. {saltate} lines were not reversed: they were not posted.
correggi.nulla_da_correggere: This sheet has no posted lines: there is nothing to correct.
correggi.gia_corretta: Already corrected by sheet {codice}: open that one and work there.
correggi.e_stata_corretta_da: This sheet has already been corrected by {codice}

saldi.in_lavorazione_aiuto: Already entered on a sheet and not yet posted: they do not reduce the outstanding amount.
saldi.incassato_non_disponibile: The collected amount is not available at this level: it is not zero, it is unknown.
saldi.nessun_movimento: Nothing has arrived on this document yet.
saldi.non_letto: The balance could not be read: retry before concluding there is nothing left to pay.
saldi.livello_non_pronto: The balance for this level is not available yet.
saldi.include_riga_corrente: The amount in progress also includes this line: at this level the balance cannot exclude it.

blocchi.per_chi_aiuto: A hold says who it is for: choose the party or write a note. It stops other issues until you release it.

blocco.giacenza_insufficiente: Insufficient stock: the outgoing quantity exceeds what the ledger shows on hand for the item, or for the given lot or serial.
blocco.merce_bloccata: The goods are there, but part of them is already committed to others: the free quantity does not cover the requested issue.

disponibilita.search_placeholder: Search by item code or description…
disponibilita.solo_negativa_hint: Commitments that can no longer be met: available below zero.
disponibilita.negativa_tooltip: Commitment that can no longer be met: committed goods exceed what is on the ledger.
disponibilita.blocchi_nessuno: No open commitment: availability changed since the list was read.
disponibilita.blocchi_non_letti: Could not load the open commitments.

blocco.articolo_non_gestito: The item is not stock-managed: no movement can be recorded.
blocco.lotto_obbligatorio: The item is tracked by lot: specify the lot.
blocco.lotto_non_ammesso: The item is not tracked by lot: the lot must not be specified.
blocco.lotto_di_altro_articolo: The lot does not belong to the item, or is no longer active.
blocco.seriale_obbligatorio: The item is tracked by serial: specify the serial.
blocco.seriale_non_ammesso: The item is not tracked by serial: the serial must not be specified.
blocco.seriale_di_altro_articolo: The serial does not belong to the item, or is no longer active.
blocco.seriale_di_altro_emittente: The serial does not belong to the warehouse's issuer.
blocco.ubicazione_obbligatoria: The warehouse uses locations: specify the location.
blocco.ubicazione_non_ammessa: The warehouse does not use locations: the location must not be specified.
blocco.ubicazione_di_altro_magazzino: The location does not belong to the warehouse, or is no longer active.

inventari.conferma_elimina: Delete stock count #{id}? Only a draft can be deleted.
inventari.nessuna_riga: The stock count has no lines yet: add the counted positions.

piano.aiuto: This is what posting will write, position by position. Uncounted positions stay as they are on the ledger.
piano.riepilogo: {con_delta} with a difference · {invariate} unchanged · {non_contate} not counted · {non_postabili} not postable.
piano.non_postabili_avviso: There are lines that cannot be posted: while they exist, posting rejects the whole document.
piano.nessuna_riga: The plan is empty: no counted position and nothing on the ledger for this warehouse.

rettifiche.conferma_elimina: Delete adjustment #{id}? Only a draft can be deleted.
rettifiche.nessuna_riga: The adjustment has no lines yet: add the corrections.

documenti_interni.magazzino_aiuto: The warehouse is chosen now and cannot be changed: it sets the scope and whether lines require a location.
documenti_interni.data_aiuto: The date of the count or of the correction: it sets the movement date at posting.
documenti_interni.righe_congelate: Lines can only be edited in draft: bring the document back to draft to change them.

registra_reason.non_confermato: The document is not confirmed yet: confirm it to post.
registra_reason.gia_registrato: The document is already posted: the movements are on the ledger.
registra_reason.annullato: The document is cancelled: it cannot be posted.
registra_reason.senza_righe: The document has no lines: there is nothing to post.
registra_reason.righe_non_postabili: One or more lines would not pass posting: fix them in the lines list.

registra.irreversibile: Posting writes the movements on the ledger and cannot be undone.
registra.riepilogo_piano: {con_delta} with a difference · {non_contate} not counted, left as they are.

stato_info.posted: Posted: the movements are on the ledger. To correct them, open an adjustment.
stato_info.cancel: Cancelled: the document is closed and cannot be reopened. Open a new one if needed.

riga.campo_articolo_placeholder: Search by code or description (min 3 characters)
riga.articolo_non_gestito: The item is not stock-managed: the line is saved, but it will not be postable.
riga.aiuto_qta_contata: What is on the shelf, in the base unit. Zero is a value: the position is empty.
riga.aiuto_qta_delta: Positive adds, negative removes. Cannot be zero.
riga.aiuto_costo: Empty = at the current ledger average.
riga.nessun_lotto: No active lot for this item: create one from Configuration → Tables → Lots.
riga.nessun_seriale: No active serial for this item in this warehouse.
riga.non_postabile: As it is, the line will not pass posting: {motivo}

magazzini.hint_codice_lockato: The code cannot be changed after creation.
magazzini.hint_senza_emittente: This session has no issuer to write to: choose one at the top.
magazzini.hint_indirizzo: An address of the issuing company (headquarters, depot): pick one of its addresses, or add one.
magazzini.usa_indirizzo: Use this address for the warehouse
magazzini.indirizzo_libero_non_ammesso: A free-text address cannot be used for a warehouse: a structured address is required.

magazzini.hint_attivo: Inactive, the warehouse is no longer offered; the database refuses deactivation with active children.

ubicazioni.magazzino_non_le_usa: This warehouse does not use locations: the rows below do not enter movements while the flag is off.
ubicazioni.conferma_disattiva: Deactivate location {codice}? With active children or movements the database refuses.
ubicazioni.hint_parent: A location of the same warehouse (area → aisle → shelf…). Empty = root.
ubicazioni.hint_attivo: Inactive, the location is no longer offered in movements.

lotti.articolo_non_per_lotti: This item is not tracked by batch: the batches below do not enter movements while the “by batch” flag is off.
lotti.conferma_disattiva: Deactivate batch {codice}? With movements or rows naming it the database refuses.
lotti.hint_data_arrivo: Rotation (FIFO) is counted from this date.
lotti.hint_data_scadenza: Empty = the batch does not expire. Cannot precede the arrival.
lotti.hint_attivo: Inactive, the batch is no longer offered in movements.
